messages:
alex: Heads-up — started canary rollout of routing-policy v2 to 10% (12:05 UTC). Keep an eye on console dashboards and quota/billing telemetry.

priya: Noticed a weird flash on the quota graph for org-A around 12:10 — showed tokens belonging to org-B for ~2s. Looks like a scoping leak.

carlos: Repro steps: quick-switch org in console, open /insights/usage -> graph shows another org's datapoints. Tried twice.

sam: v2 added an aggressive prefetch + cookie-affinity optimization. Could be cache key normalization bug (prefetch populates sidecar cache without org context).

alex: @sam can you paste the sidecar logs for a repro trace? also @deploy-bot did canary report any anomalies?

sam: logs excerpt: ```
http.request id=0x9f3 GET /api/console/metrics?org=org-A
headers: x-org-id: org-A; cookie: session=abc123
sidecar.cache: HIT key=route:session:abc123 -> route=sidecar-7
response: 200
---
later request same session but key resolved to route=sidecar-2 with header x-org-id: org-B
```

priya: Telemetry pipeline shows ingestion with missing x-org-id on some events, those got attributed to the upstream default (org-B). That's why dashboards momentarily display other org's metrics.

deploy-bot: Canary v2 at 10% from 12:05 UTC. Alert: cross-tenant-metric-association spike at 12:11 UTC. See #incidents.

alex: Rolling back canary v2 now. Initiating rollback to routing-policy v1.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 12:23 UTC. Traffic back to v1 for all canary nodes.

carlos: Minimal repro and logs uploaded: https://github.com/redwood/internal/issues/546 (private). Looks like cache key omits org-id when prefetch path used.

priya: Hypothesis: prefetch path computes cache key as `sessionid + route` but forgets to include `orgid`. Patch suggestion: canonical cache key should be `orgid|sessionid|route`. Need to audit other prefetch codepaths.

sam: I can hotfix the cache key in sidecar and push a patch. Also agree we should tighten rollout smoke tests — include a cross-org-sanity check that validates dashboard assignment. Our current smoke only checks 200 OK.

alex: Action items (assign): 1) hotfix cache key and patch release (sam), 2) add smoke test + dashboard assertion (priya), 3) run telemetry scrub for misattributed events and create audit log for legal (carlos), 4) update rollout playbook to include cross-tenant verification (alex).

priya: I'll own the smoke tests + a monitoring rule that fires if any organid appears in another org's stream for >1s. Will open PR.

carlos: Starting a scrub job to re-label/mask events; will backfill corrected org tags where possible and record changes. Will coordinate with compliance.

sam: Patch branch: https://github.com/redwood/routing/pull/1234 — fixes cache key; includes unit tests. Will queue for hotfix cherrypick.

alex: Thanks all. Please post status updates here. If anyone sees more cross-tenant flashes, ping me directly and escalate to eng-sre.

priya: FYI adding `canary-smoke: cross-org-metrics-sanity` to rollout pipeline. Should catch this next time. :white_check_mark:

carlos: I've started the scrub and will post a short report by EOD.

sam: Hotfix ready, starting rollout to staging now.

alex: Good work. We'll reconvene after scrub + hotfix validation.
